REPAIR.name: Repair
REPAIR.description: Restores eligible mechanical targets and structures while spending resources. The repairer must remain able to work; this is not biological healing.

CALL_DOWN_MULE.name: Call Down MULE
CALL_DOWN_MULE.description: Spends energy to summon a temporary mineral worker. The MULE does not replace permanent worker production and disappears when its lifetime ends.

SCANNER_SWEEP.name: Scanner Sweep
SCANNER_SWEEP.description: Spends energy for temporary vision and detection over an area. Competes with MULE expenditure on that same Orbital Command.

CALLDOWN_EXTRA_SUPPLIES.name: Calldown: Extra Supplies
CALLDOWN_EXTRA_SUPPLIES.description: Adds supply through a valid Supply Depot target. The supply is tied to that structure; it is not a map-wide invulnerable supply source.

LIFT_LAND.name: Lift / Land
LIFT_LAND.description: Changes a building between flying and grounded states. Flying disables normal production; landing needs a legal footprint and add-on alignment. Planetary Fortress cannot lift.

LOWER_RAISE.name: Lower / Raise
LOWER_RAISE.description: Opens or closes a ground passage while retaining the same Depot asset. Nearby units can prevent a requested raise.

LOAD_UNLOAD.name: Load / Unload
LOAD_UNLOAD.description: Stores and releases eligible passengers within cargo limits. Bunker passengers can fire from inside; Medivac passengers normally cannot.

SALVAGE.name: Salvage
SALVAGE.description: Removes the Bunker after a delay and refunds resources under its salvage rules. It sacrifices the defensive position rather than repairing it.

STIMPACK.name: Stimpack
STIMPACK.description: After research, spends the user's health for temporary movement and attack-speed increases. Repeated use without healing can make the army vulnerable.

KD8_CHARGE.name: KD8 Charge
KD8_CHARGE.description: Throws a timed explosive that damages and displaces eligible ground targets. It can disrupt workers and spacing; it is not a sustained weapon replacement.

CLOAK.name: Cloak
CLOAK.description: Requires Personal Cloaking research and energy. Concealment does not prevent detection or all area damage.

EMP_ROUND.name: EMP Round
EMP_ROUND.description: Area effect against shields and energy, with revealing interactions. Valuable against shield-heavy forces and casters; it does not simply remove ordinary health.

STEADY_TARGETING_SNIPE.name: Steady Targeting / Snipe
STEADY_TARGETING_SNIPE.description: Channels a high-damage shot at an eligible biological target. Target legality, channel interruption, and target movement can prevent completion.

TACTICAL_NUKE.name: Tactical Nuke
TACTICAL_NUKE.description: Requires a prepared missile from the Ghost Academy and a valid designation. The delayed strike exposes a warning and can be stopped by interrupting the designator.

SIEGE_UNSIEGE.name: Siege / Unsiege
SIEGE_UNSIEGE.description: Exchanges mobility and direct fire for stationary ground splash at longer range. Siege fire has a minimum engagement distance; it does not attack aircraft.

BURROW_UNBURROW.name: Burrow / Unburrow
BURROW_UNBURROW.description: Arms or repositions the mine. Its automated shot can target eligible ground or air units; reload and concealment rules matter between shots.

LOCK_ON.name: Lock On
LOCK_ON.description: Sustained damage against a chosen legal target while maintaining the ability's tracking conditions. Breaking contact, losing the target, or being forced out can stop useful damage.

TRANSFORM.name: Transform
TRANSFORM.description: Changes between a mobile line-fire vehicle and a short-range area attacker with a Biological interaction. Requires Armory tech; the unit keeps its identity and accumulated damage.

SWITCH_ANTI_AIR_MODE.name: Switch anti-air mode
SWITCH_ANTI_AIR_MODE.description: Changes the anti-air weapon's role between area damage and focused heavy-target fire. Ground attack remains a separate weapon.

ASSAULT_FIGHTER_MODE.name: Assault / Fighter mode
ASSAULT_FIGHTER_MODE.description: Lands for ground attacks or takes off for anti-air attacks. The two forms cover different target categories and movement spaces.

HEAL.name: Heal
HEAL.description: Spends energy to restore eligible biological units. Does not repair mechanical units; proximity, energy, and target eligibility constrain it.

IGNITE_AFTERBURNERS.name: Ignite Afterburners
IGNITE_AFTERBURNERS.description: Temporary speed increase on cooldown. Useful for travel or escape, but does not remove threats at the destination.

CLOAKING_FIELD.name: Cloaking Field
CLOAKING_FIELD.description: Requires research and energy. Allows concealed ground harassment but provides no anti-air weapon or immunity to detection.

AUTO_TURRET.name: Auto-Turret
AUTO_TURRET.description: Spends energy to place a temporary attacking structure at a legal location. The turret can be attacked and expires.

INTERFERENCE_MATRIX.name: Interference Matrix
INTERFERENCE_MATRIX.description: Temporarily disables eligible mechanical or psionic targets' offensive abilities. Research requirements differ across balance versions; check the baseline command set.

ANTI_ARMOR_MISSILE.name: Anti-Armor Missile
ANTI_ARMOR_MISSILE.description: Applies a temporary armor-related debuff around the impact. It supports follow-up damage; it is not the old direct-damage missile from earlier versions.

DEFENDER_MODE.name: Defender mode
DEFENDER_MODE.description: Establishes a stationary ground firing zone; only legal units in that zone can be attacked by its ground weapon. Repositioning requires leaving the mode.

TACTICAL_JUMP.name: Tactical Jump
TACTICAL_JUMP.description: Relocates to a selected map point after a cast delay. It uses a cooldown rather than caster energy and does not require prior vision of the destination. Damage and interruption risks remain during the cast.

YAMATO_CANNON.name: Yamato Cannon
YAMATO_CANNON.description: Requires Weapon Refit research; fires a high-damage targeted shot after a cast. The target must be legal, and casting is separate from a successful hit.
